title: Governed agent-ontology layer hardens into the enterprise-agent moat by Q4 2026
body: The governed semantic/ontology layer that sits between raw warehouse data and the agents querying it is becoming the contested center of enterprise AI, and by Q4 2026 a second major data platform will ship a directly comparable governed agent-context surface, confirming the category rather than any single vendor. The Snowflake Summit Builder Keynote made the shape explicit: Cortex Sense auto-builds a metadata-to-ontology layer on top of the Horizon Context governance layer so agents consume one shared definition of skills and semantics, demonstrated with BlackRock running its agents off a single Horizon Context definition of enterprise truth and Sanofi's Concierge agent prepping reps off live data. The reason this is a moat and not a feature is that an agent is only as trustworthy as the semantic and governance layer it reads from; whoever owns that layer owns where enterprise agents run, regardless of which model sits on top. The same keynote pushed open table formats toward table stakes by taking Iceberg v3 with Polaris bi-directional writes to GA, letting external engines like Spark and Trino write into governed tables with no duplication, which removes lock-in as the differentiator and forces the fight up to the governance-and-ontology layer. Databricks Data + AI Summit on June 15-18, with dedicated governance and agent tracks, is the most likely near-term venue for a parallel Unity-Catalog-anchored agent-context/ontology announcement, and additional pressure should come from at least one more platform or an open-standard proposal extending a catalog into an agent-consumable semantic layer before year end.

reasoning.given: An agent trusts only the governed layer it reads, so that layer decides where enterprise agents run
reasoning.so_that: A second major data platform ships a comparable governed agent-context/ontology layer, making the category the moat
reasoning.landing: by Q4 2026; Databricks Data+AI Summit Jun 15-18 the likely first move
reasoning.plain_language: Whoever owns the trusted, governed map of company data controls where AI agents run, so rival data clouds race to build that map too.

summary: The governed semantic layer agents read from is becoming the enterprise-AI moat: whoever owns the trusted definition of company data owns where agents run, not the model. After Snowflake shipped Cortex Sense plus Iceberg v3 bi-directional writes, expect a rival to ship a comparable layer by Q4 2026.
